sources.title: DESNZ Carbon budget and growth delivery plan — heat and buildings factsheet
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Carbon budget and growth delivery plan — heat and buildings factsheet.
Factsheet describes heat/buildings policies including low-carbon heating, heat pumps, heat networks and insulation.
Policy/delivery-plan material; not observed parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: planned methodology changes
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: planned methodology changes.
Page publishes planned 2026 methodology changes for annual UK GHG estimates.
Methodology-change notice; not a new emissions observation.

sources.title: DESNZ Independent Review of Greenhouse Gas Removals: terms of reference
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Independent Review of Greenhouse Gas Removals: terms of reference.
Terms of reference define the purpose and scope of the independent GGR review.
Governance/scope document; not measured removals.

sources.title: UK ETS Authority — long-term pathway for the UK Emissions Trading Scheme
facts: Official public source reviewed: UK ETS Authority — long-term pathway for the UK Emissions Trading Scheme.
Long-term pathway sets scheme-cap and expansion policy, including domestic maritime and future waste-incineration coverage.
Policy trajectory/allowance scope; not physical parcel emissions.

sources.title: DESNZ Heat Pump Deployment statistics collection
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Heat Pump Deployment statistics collection.
Collection provides provisional quarterly counts of UK hydronic heat-pump installations up to 45kW.
Technology deployment counts; not direct GHG measurement.

sources.title: DfT Vehicle licensing statistics: January to March 2026
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Vehicle licensing statistics: January to March 2026.
At end-March 2026 there were 2.148 million licensed zero-emission vehicles, 5.1% of all licensed vehicles.
Vehicle stock/registration statistics; not direct GHG measurement.

sources.title: DfT Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics collection
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics collection.
Collection lists the 2025 fifth provisional SAF release and states provisional data are subject to change before final publication.
Fuel-supply/mandate statistics; provisional status must be preserved.

sources.title: DESNZ Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics collection
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics collection.
Collection tracks provisional monthly and cumulative voucher applications and redemptions for low-carbon heating grants.
Scheme uptake; not measured GHG outcome.

sources.title: DESNZ Heat pump deployment statistics: March 2026
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Heat pump deployment statistics: March 2026.
Official statistics in development monitor UK hydronic heat-pump installations up to 45kW.
Deployment statistics; provisional/development status must be preserved.

sources.title: DESNZ Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics: May 2026
facts: Official public source reviewed: DESNZ Boiler Upgrade Scheme statistics: May 2026.
Release reports BUS uptake including voucher applications, redemptions and installation costs for England and Wales.
Scheme uptake/costs; not direct emissions measurement.

sources.title: DfT Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection.
Collection lists the 2025 fifth provisional RTFO release and explains provisional fuel volumes can change before the final report.
Low-carbon fuel supply statistics; provisional/final distinction required.

sources.title: DfT Transport and environment statistics: 2024
facts: Official public source reviewed: DfT Transport and environment statistics: 2024.
Domestic transport emitted 110.4 MtCO2e in 2024 and accounted for 30% of total domestic UK GHG emissions.
National/mode transport statistics; not parcel GHG measurement.
